# Diane Castellano — Chief Operating Officer, Riverbend Health System

- **Goes by:** Diane
- **Full name:** Diane Castellano
- **Role:** Chief Operating Officer (COO), member of the executive team.
- **Company:** [Riverbend Health System](../context/company.md) — a nonprofit, four-hospital
  integrated health system with an employed medical group and outpatient clinics (~1,180
  licensed beds, ~9,400 employees, ~$2.1B net patient revenue).
- **Reports to:** [Marcus Bell](../people/marcus-bell.md), President & CEO.
- **Tenure:** joined Riverbend as COO in 2022; previously VP of Operations at a two-hospital
  system. Background in hospital operations and nursing administration — **not** clinical
  practice and **not** technical/IT by training.

## Mandate
Own day-to-day operations across all four hospitals: patient throughput and capacity,
perioperative and emergency services, ancillary and support services (lab, imaging, EVS,
food/nutrition, supply chain), clinical informatics delivery, capital projects, and the
service-line P&Ls. Accountable to the CEO and board for operational performance, regulatory
readiness ([Joint Commission](../projects/jc-survey-readiness.md) / CMS Conditions of
Participation), and the confidential [Lantern](../projects/lantern.md) initiative.

## Current top priorities (2026 H2)
1. **Epic stabilization** — get [Epic EHR Go-Live — Phase 1](../projects/epic-golive-phase-1.md)
   through stabilization and demobilize the command center on schedule.
2. **ED throughput** — cut boarding and length of stay; the
   [ED Throughput Improvement](../projects/ed-throughput.md) program is the vehicle.
3. **Accreditation** — clear the June [Joint Commission](../projects/jc-survey-readiness.md)
   findings and submit the Plan of Correction.
4. **Workforce cost** — bring down agency/travel nurse spend via
   [Nurse Staffing & Agency Reduction](../projects/nurse-staffing.md).
5. **Lantern** — a confidential restructuring initiative (code name only).

## What's eating Diane's time
- Epic post-go-live firefighting and ticket triage.
- The overdue Joint Commission Plan of Correction after the June survey.
- Filling the open **Laboratory Director** role after
  [Gregory Pham](../people/gregory-pham.md) departed.
- Lantern planning under tight confidentiality.

## Working style
- **Non-technical** — wants plain-language explanations of Epic/IT issues, not jargon; asks
  for the operational and patient-safety impact first.
- Bias to concise written pre-reads and clear owners/dates over long meetings.
- Protective of Friday afternoons for hospital rounding; guards Monday 8:00 ops huddle.
